expect_red: Add a face over a feature holding the same bind twice writes one event that leaves one binding, the union -- where it used to leave three standing and two sets disagreeing

mutations.contract: A set write over several standing feature-keyed bindings replaces them all.
mutations.note: Declared with the guard by handoff a_disagreement_is_settled_by_keep_or_let_go (2026-11-18). The pre-fix rule: a correction only over exactly one standing binding, else a plain bind beside them -- how event 0095 made a second set.
